name: La Casa de la Playa

address.street: Carretera Chetumal-Puerto Juárez Km. 282 L23-2 Colonia Rancho Xcaret 77710

insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary sits on one of the Riviera Maya's most pristine stretches of sand, where ancient Mayan cenotes meet contemporary Mexican design.
whats_special: La Casa de la Playa features only 63 suites, making it one of Mexico's most exclusive beach resorts. The property showcases authentic Mexican artistry with handcrafted furnishings, locally-sourced materials, and a world-class spa built around a natural cenote. Each suite offers direct beach access and personalized butler service.
pro_tip: Book the Cenote Spa experience at sunrise - you'll have the underground sacred pool virtually to yourself while enjoying traditional Mayan healing rituals.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant helmed by a James Beard-nominated chef serves elevated Mexican cuisine with ingredients from their organic garden. Take the complimentary bike ride to nearby Xcaret eco-park, or explore the colorful streets of Playa del Carmen's Fifth Avenue, just minutes away.
pros: Sophisticated adults-only beachfront sanctuary with pristine white sand access
World-class spa and wellness facilities with holistic treatments
Exceptional culinary program featuring multiple gourmet restaurants
Luxurious suites with private terraces and premium amenities
cons: Adults-only property not suitable for families with children
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
